description: This file defines the Zend_Http_CookieJar class, which manages HTTP cookies by storing, adding, retrieving, and processing cookie data within a PHP project. It includes methods for handling cookies automatically from HTTP responses, manually adding cookies, and extracting cookies based on URI matching; it also implements interfaces for countability and iteration over stored cookies.

classes.name: Zend_Http_CookieJar
classes.description: A class that handles storing, managing, and retrieving HTTP cookies, supporting operations such as adding cookies from strings or objects, parsing cookies from HTTP responses, and filtering cookies based on URI matching.

methods.name: addCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the jar, accepting either a Zend_Http_Cookie object or a string to create one.

methods.name: addCookiesFromResponse
methods.description: Parses an HTTP response to extract and store all 'Set-Cookie' headers into the jar.

methods.name: getAllCookies
methods.description: Retrieves all stored cookies in a specified format (object array or strings).

methods.name: getMatchingCookies
methods.description: Returns cookies matching a specific URI, considering path, domain, and expiry.

methods.name: getCookie
methods.description: Retrieves a specific cookie by URI and cookie name, with options for return format.

methods.name: _flattenCookiesArray
methods.description: Helper method to recursively flatten nested cookies array into a flat array or string.

methods.name: _matchDomain
methods.description: Filters stored cookies to those matching a specific domain.

methods.name: _matchPath
methods.description: Filters cookies to those matching a specific path within a domain.

methods.name: fromResponse
methods.description: Creates a CookieJar instance populated with cookies from an HTTP response.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of cookies stored in the jar.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator for looping over stored cookies.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the cookie jar contains any cookies.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all cookies from the jar.
